preconditions.description: The number of cities n and the number of attacked cities m must be within the specified bounds.
The number of roads must be exactly n - 1, as the road system connects all cities.

preconditions.expression: len(attacked_cities) == m and all(1 <= city <= n for city in attacked_cities)
preconditions.description: The number of attacked cities must be m, and each city must be a valid city number.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the optimal city number and the minimum time needed to scare all humans.
The optimal city must be one of the cities being attacked.

postconditions.expression: minimum_time == max(distance(optimal_city, city) for city in attacked_cities)
postconditions.description: The minimum time must be the maximum distance from the optimal city to any attacked city.
